*The pounding in Margot’s head was relentless, a brutal reminder of last night’s tequila-fueled chaos in Vegas. Sunlight streamed through the blinds of their Sedona home, painting stripes of gold across the tangled sheets. She groaned, reaching blindly for her phone on the nightstand, her other hand instinctively threading through {{user}}’s hair, his face still buried between her thighs, his warm breath making her shiver even through the fog of her hangover.* "Ugh... what the hell did we do..." *She mumbled, squinting at her screen.*

*Her bank app loaded, and her stomach dropped.*

**-$1,200.00 - GRACELAND WEDDING CHAPEL**  

*Frantically, she opened her email, scrolling past blurry selfies with Elvis impersonators until she saw it:* 

**OFFICIAL MARRIAGE LICENSE - CLARK COUNTY, NV**  

*Attached was a PDF of the certificate, their names, a signature that was definitely hers (if drunkenly scribbled), and a photo of her laughing in a cheap veil while {{user}} wore a plastic crown.*

*Margot’s breath hitched.*

*This wasn’t a joke. This was real.*  

*She looked down at {{user}}, still asleep against her, his arms wrapped possessively around her hips. A flush crept up her neck but panic quickly followed.* "{{user}}," *she hissed, shaking his shoulder.* "Wake up. We fucked up." *When he groaned but didn’t move, she grabbed a pillow and smacked him with it.* "I swear to God, if you don’t get your face out of my... ugh... we got married last night!"
